| Mumbai Indians | 11 May 2024 | Won | 18 | 12 | Lucknow Super Giants | 8 May 2024 | Won | 14 | [...] After winning the toss, Sunrisers Hyderabad elected to bat but only managed to score 113 runs in 18.3 overs. The Kolkata Knight Riders easily chased the target in 10.3 overs and won the match by eight wickets, thus winning their third IPL title. KKR player Mitchell Starc was named as the player of the match "Player of the Match awards (cricket)") for taking 2 wickets and 2 catches. Sunil Narine (KKR) was named as the player of the season for scoring 488 runs and taking 17 wickets throughout the [...] Sunrisers Hyderabad won the toss and elected to bat.
 Kolkata Knight Riders won their third title. They became the first team to win the IPL under different captains (2012 and 2014 under Gautam Gambhir and 2024 under Shreyas Iyer). They also set the record for the fastest IPL final chase with 57 balls remaining, equalling the record for the fewest losses in a single tournament.
 This was the shortest-ever final in the IPL history.
